subject: Aaron Patel — start-date clearance & onboarding playbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aaron Patel — kickoff for start-date clearance

Hi all,

Aaron accepted the Senior Infra Engineer offer yesterday and his signed DocuSign came through (attached). He's targeting a start date of Monday, June 7. I opened a case with our background vendor (ClearCheck) but want to confirm internal steps and timeline so we can lock IT provisioning and the first-week calendar.

Quick asks:
- Monica: can you kick off the vendor request and send the candidate consent (I copied the verification checklist we use).
- Markus: engineering onboarding buddy + access matrix (we can reuse the June onboarding template).
- Laura: payroll/benefits handoff — do we need any additional candidate docs on file before 6/7?

Attachments: offer-aaron-patel-docusign.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I’ll share the vendor status link when I have it.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: ClearCheck HR <hr@clearcheck.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:05:14 -0700
Subject: Background & employment verification request — Aaron Patel (candidate)

Hi ClearCheck team,

Please open a new verification for Aaron Patel (DOB 1992-08-11, candidate email aaron.patel@gmail.com). Candidate has signed the offer and attached the consent form. We need standard background + employment verification completed by no later than Friday, June 4 so IT can provision accounts the week of 6/1.

Candidate details:
- Role: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
- Manager: Markus Klein
- Location: Remote (PST)

Attachments: consent-aaron-patel.pdf (pdf)
Priority: expedited — please confirm receipt and the expected completion ETA.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
People Ops Coordinator | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
From: ClearCheck HR <hr@clearcheck.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:30:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Background & employment verification request — Aaron Patel (candidate)

Hi Monica / Kimberly,

Thanks — we received the consent and offer paperwork. Case CC-99817 is open and we've emailed Aaron to confirm identity. Current ETA: verification report and employment checks should be complete by Thursday, June 3 if we get timely responses from previous employers. You can follow progress here: https://app.clearcheck.io/portal/cases/CC-99817

Notes:
- We flagged the employment verification for two prior employers (AcmeCloud, 2018-2021; BitWave, 2021-2024). Past-employer responses typically take 2–5 business days.
- If you want us to escalate, please reply and we'll mark it high priority; expedited turnaround incurs $150 rush fee.

Best,
Rita Gomez
Account Manager | ClearCheck HR
hr@clearcheck.io
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:40:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Aaron Patel — start-date clearance & onboarding playbook

Kim / Markus —

Thanks for the heads-up. Payroll: I have Aaron's signed W-4 and completed I-9 intake scheduled for Tue 6/1 (we'll use remote verification). No outstanding paperwork on our side, so long as ClearCheck finishes verification by 6/4 we are good to set a firm 6/7 start.

On IT: Markus, please confirm the access list (SSH, internal tickets, GCP project names). I'll trigger the account create on 6/1 once ClearCheck status shows "Verification complete" and we have the final start date.

Forwarding the vendor update below for context.

Action items I own:
- Finalize access spreadsheet by 6/1 (will send to IT ops and security).
- Quick intro call with Aaron on 6/3 at 10:00 AM PT (15 minutes) — Kim, can you coordinate?
